items.title: 从 Coding 到 Anything，Agent 正在重写工作流
items.raw_excerpt: 从最初的代码补全、函数生成，到围绕一个需求完成多文件修改、调试和测试，AI 在开发流程中的位置正在不断前移。今天的 Coding Agent，已经不再只是回答问题或生成片段，而是开始承担更完整的任务链路：理解需求、调研方案、生成代码、运行验证、修复问题，甚至完成代码评审。

title_i18n.zh: 从 Coding 到 Anything，Agent 正在重写工作流
title_i18n.en: From Coding to Anything, Agent is rewriting workflows.
title_i18n.es: De Coding a Anything, Agent está reescribiendo el flujo de trabajo.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 从最初的代码补全、函数生成，到围绕一个需求完成多文件修改、调试和测试，AI 在开发流程中的位置正在不断前移。今天的 Coding Agent，已经不再只是回答问题或生成片段，而是开始承担更完整的任务链路：理解需求、调研方案、生成代码、运行验证、修复问题，甚至完成代码评审。
excerpt_i18n.en: From initial code completion and function generation to multi-file modification, debugging, and testing around a single requirement, AI's position in the development workflow is continuously moving forward. Today's Coding Agent is no longer just answering questions or generating snippets; it has begun to take on more complete task chains: understanding requirements, researching solutions, generating code, running verification, fixing issues, and even completing code reviews.
excerpt_i18n.es: Desde la autocompletación de código y la generación de funciones iniciales, hasta la realización de modificaciones en múltiples archivos, depuración y pruebas en torno a una necesidad, la posición de la IA en el flujo de desarrollo avanza constantemente. El Coding Agent actual ya no se limita a responder preguntas o generar fragmentos, sino que comienza a asumir cadenas de tareas más completas: comprender requisitos, investigar soluciones, generar código, ejecutar validaciones, corregir problemas e incluso realizar revisiones de código.

excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past six years, domestic GPU companies have ridden the AI wave, with valuations constantly refreshed, but DPUs have been overlooked. This does not match industry reality. After NVIDIA acquired Mellanox in 2020, it clearly defined its "GPU+CPU+DPU" three-chip strategy. In the past few years, NVIDIA has continuously strengthened its networking capabilities. At the 2026 CES, Huang Jen-Hsun showcased a "six-chip combo," four of which were networking-related. An increasingly clear trend is emerging: the bottleneck in AI infrastructure is shifting from computing power itself to networking and scheduling. Especially with the arrival of the Agent era, AI systems are moving from training to high-frequency inference and continuous operation, with GPU utilization increasingly dependent on network efficiency. The DPU has gradually evolved from an optional component in data centers to a critical role in AI infrastructure. However, a thought-provoking question is: since NVIDIA has long bet on DPUs, why has the entire industry still underestimated DPUs over the past six years? It was not until Cloud Leopard Intelligence's IPO filing for the first domestic DPU stock was accepted by the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, and the prospectus was presented to everyone, that the market began to realize that a full-featured DPU supporting low latency, high bandwidth, and high-performance data scheduling might be the most underestimated piece of the AI infrastructure puzzle. A big-chip track underestimated for six years. In the past few years, the focus of competition in the AI industry has always been on GPUs. Larger model parameters, stronger single-card performance, and more expensive HBM have attracted almost all the industry's attention.
excerpt_i18n.es: Durante los últimos seis años, las empresas nacionales de GPU han estado en la cresta de la tendencia de la IA, con valoraciones que se actualizan constantemente, mientras que las DPU han sido ignoradas. Esto no se ajusta a la realidad industrial. Tras la adquisición de Mellanox por NVIDIA en 2020, ya se definió claramente la estrategia de «tres chips: GPU+CPU+DPU». En los últimos años, NVIDIA ha seguido fortaleciendo sus capacidades de red, y cuando Jensen Huang mostró la «combinación de seis chips» en el CES 2026, cuatro de ellos estaban relacionados con redes. Una tendencia cada vez más clara está empezando a emerger: el cuello de botella de la infraestructura de IA está pasando de la propia capacidad de cómputo a la red y la programación. Especialmente tras la llegada de la era de los agentes, los sistemas de IA están comenzando a pasar del entrenamiento a la inferencia de alta frecuencia.

excerpt_i18n.en: In the past, reviewing highlight moments from football matches required editors to sift through footage, find goals, celebrations, slow-motion replays, and audience reactions, then cut, package, add subtitles, and finally distribute to different platforms. The process was lengthy and labor-intensive, and capturing traffic from trending moments depended entirely on human experience and reaction speed. Now, this workflow has been broken down and reassembled, with models and toolchains taking over the entire production pipeline for sports highlight videos. In this new chain, AI can already understand live streams in real time, recognize signals such as camera switches, audio changes, player celebrations, and referee whistles, quickly return highlight clips after key events, and generate ready-to-distribute standalone segments. By the time a trending moment erupts, the video is already ready. The underlying change is not just that a specific tool has become more efficient; it is that the production of audio and video content is evolving from a human-driven workflow to an agent-driven workflow. This is not just about using models to generate and process audio and video content, but also about forming new production tools and new production processes on this basis, truly approaching the ideal state of "one sentence to create a finished video." This paradigm shift in video production requires support from a new technical foundation. Hang Mengyu, product lead for the Volcano Engine AI Media Platform, mentioned at the Intelligent Video Cloud sub-forum of the 2026 Summer FORCE Conference that moving from "generating a segment of footage" to "delivering a finished video that can go live, be consumed, and be distributed to audiences" still requires a full set of professional audio and video processing work.
